name: Runtime undeclared common output rejection at output validation — Go/Java/C++ byte-exact
description: Companion to runtime_undeclared_item_output.json for the common channel (issue #205). recall_static's `set_common` keys are config-derived field names; recall_static's own doc comment already required them to be declared in common_output for the DAG to build read edges, but nothing enforced it. Two undeclared keys are used to lock the multi-field list shape: bytewise-sorted, space-separated, no quotes or commas — identical to the existing type-violation list format. The common channel is checked before the item channel, so a config violating both reports only the common fields.

expected_error.wrapping_exact: pine: execution error in operator "seed_items": output contract violation: operator wrote undeclared common output field(s) [request_id trace_id]
